def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number, not bool")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative and finite")

    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have positive dimensions")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive log probabilities")

    # Ensure all arrays have the same shape
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape

    # T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum == 0.0:
        raise ValueError("Zero weight sum (horizon too large?)")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # T02: Compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log probability)
    def weighted_loss(logp):
        return -np.dot(logp, normalized_weights)  # shape (n_candidates,)

    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # T03: Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # T04: Filtering threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
